ios.desc:
If yes, this app is for you. "Plane Above Me" answers that exact question.  

You can scan the sky manually by pressing its Scan button or let the app auto-detect flights. Once it detects the sound of aircrafts, it will retrieve live flight data for you. Behind the scenes, it uses AI sound classification models to achieve that. 

Privacy friendly:

1) Location data is used for scanning for flights nearby only. It is never stored and sent anywhere.
2) If activated, audio data is analyzed on device for aircraft sound identification only. It is never stored and sent anywhere.

quotes.text:
Experimented with the new sound recognition SDK in iOS; to expand our toolbox to create cool experiences.

I have always been fascinated by aviation. When an aircraft flies above me, I often wonder: what kind of airplane is it? A 737 or Bombardier? Where is it flying towards? At what speed?

How?

The app uses iPhone’s mic to sense the presence of aircraft sounds. Once detected, it calls flight data APIs, reads out the flight details, show photos of that particular aircraft above you and its current flight path on a map.

Cheers.
quotes.title: Show HN: Plane Above Me
